summary: Experimental community O3DE Gem integrating CodeFirstCppDB_sqlgen (C++26 reflection & modules Code-First ORM built on sqlgen and reflect-cpp) with O3DE's bundled SQLite3.
requirements: O3DE fork with C++20 module support in ly_add_target (tested on mythrz/o3de@ed33eb4c), CMake 4.5+, Ninja/Ninja Multi-Config, GCC 16.1+ for C++26 CodeFirst ORM (path service builds standalone on standard O3DE).
